title: AnyBlock file_remote payload, version 1
description: The decoded JSON inside a file object's base64 file_remote string. This payload version is independent of the enclosing AnyBlock formatVersion.

cid.description: Root file DAG CID; readers additionally check CID syntax.

encryption_keys.description: Stored encryption keys by exact DAG path, such as /0/ or /0/original/. These are not filesystem or archive paths. An empty map supplies no keys; an empty key denotes an unencrypted variant.

variants.description: Optional indexed variant metadata, in stored order. Paths must be unique and variant CIDs must be valid.
